verdict.rationale: Letta's memory system is explicitly file-based (MemFS) rather than tied to chat logs, and the SDK lets you 'pass memory for full control over the agent's starting memory' with each entry becoming a Markdown file, plus community mentions of Postgres-backed memory for non-chat use cases — suggesting the architecture supports ingesting structured/business data beyond transcripts. However, there is no explicit documentation of ingesting JSON payloads or business documents (PDFs, spreadsheets, DB records) as a first-class workflow. Missing for 10: explicit document/JSON ingestion API or connector docs, examples of loading structured business data (not just markdown notes) into memory, and independent confirmation of this working hands-on.
